stem: Your configuration sets `environment = "prod"` in four different resource `tags` blocks by repeating the string `"${var.project}-prod"` each time. A colleague suggests extracting this into a local value. What is the strongest reason to accept their suggestion?
options: Repeating the expression in four places means you must update it in four places if it ever changes; a local value means one change updates all four.
A local value is evaluated before variables, so it is more reliable in a plan.
Local values can reference resource attributes that variables cannot, making the configuration more powerful.
Extracting to a local value allows the expression to be used in other modules without any extra wiring.
objective: Explain when to use a local value instead of repeating an expression directly

options: The `locals` block must be placed inside the resource block to be referenced there.
String interpolation is not allowed inside a `locals` block.
The local value must be declared with `var.` before it can be used in a resource.
objective: Define a locals block that combines input variables and function calls into reusable named expressions, then reference them with local.<NAME> inside resource arguments

stem: You want to add a local value `short_name` that takes the first 8 characters of `local.name_prefix`. Which declaration is valid inside a `locals` block?
